The '''stole of the Panarch of Tarabon''' is a symbol of office for the [[Panarch]] of [[Tarabon]].

==Description==
The stole of the Panarch of Tarabon is a wide strip of green silk, embroidered with small golden trees, indicating Tarbon's long cultural association with [[Avendesora]], which is also displayed on its flag.
